notes.title: Fight of Steel Releases on Steam Today!
notes.content:
[h3]Today, June 14th, Digital Crafter released a whole new fighting game, Fight of Steel, after Fight of Animals was released on Steam two years ago. And we started developing free DLCs.
 
[previewyoutube=rqJOnlVLCbM;full][/previewyoutube]

Fight of Steel is a futuristic fighting game that sets its tone with metals. The story is all about fighter robots with advanced AI, aka STEEL. Players can assemble fighters with robot parts and Martial Art Chips they get in the game and develop their taste of fighting style from the look to the moves. Every STEEL a player build will be one of a kind.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/2f5398311785713cdbe397873568bc4f4c3b3b65.png[/img]
Players can buy the parts, color, basic moves, and Martial Art Chips in the shop

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/a4cd06caafaf480bc4e29f8656d5af0ea71275a7.png[/img]
The UI for fighter customization: The appearance and move sets are editable

Although a different theme from Fight of Animals, the input system is designed with the same modern approach, hoping more players can try and experience the charm of fighting games. Players can use simple inputs like pressing a direction and a skill button to perform Special moves. Fighting game veterans can also find excellent combos that require a deep understanding of the system with EX move and OVERDRIVE added to the game.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/b097179d961808d0ba00f10ff2257a300cc154f9.png[/img]
The control setting of the game

There are two other game modes in Fight of Steel, the Story Mode, and the Challenge Mode. In the Story Mode, players can join the main characters Zero and Artemis to venture into the Gears Faction area, fight the unknown enemies, and explore the world. Searching for the legendary "the Legacy of Humans," players can unlock different endings depending on the victory conditions.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/1dca5b77a1a92340d3d3a0dc879aa995f34af009.png[/img]
Story Mode screenshot 01
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/ee81ae72b7d29ad581ec06995d104b374d0309e1.png[/img]
Story Mode screenshot 02

Challenge Mode is a special kind of challenge. Players need to collect the right parts with the corresponding attributes for advantages. Different difficulties will unlock various robot parts or colors. There are World Files, some fragments of the information that describe tales about the world of Fight of Steel to collect in this Mode.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/71407d2e428517f7a1ced8b21ef61f433092ff95.png[/img]
Change attributes and stats to handle different enemies.

Fight of Steel releases on Steam today. In addition to the 10% discount on release, we planned some free DLC after release. Stay tuned.
[/h3]

notes.title: It’s time to join Steam Next Fest！！（Detailed Patch Note）
notes.content:
[h3]The Steam Next Fest in June started. Fight of Steel open demo is downloadable on Steam.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/2f64387bbc5a0bbda12dcb93bffe8096dd9c4778.jpg[/img]
We previously shared trailers for playable characters ET and Oil King. In this demo, you can redeem them freely in the Shop. ET and Oil King will stream Fight of Steel sometime this week and maybe they will be playing online matches with players. If you want to join the games, please keep an eye on our page. You might want to practice a little bit before the matches, or you want to play the game by yourself. Here are some tips for playing the game for the first time:

1. We would suggest you get familiar with the system by trying Training mode or Arcade mode. And then you can play Story mode to dip your toes in the world settings of Fight of Steel. In Story mode, there will be STEELs from the three factions showing up. We recommend you try Challenge mode later than the previous modes.

2. Online matches. You can play and practice Casual Match with your friend. If you want to challenge yourself, you could find some challenging players in Ranked Matches. Be warned, players in Ranked Matches are usually fierce.


Lastly, if you have clips of you playing the game, the interesting Skins you put together, and any thoughts you would like to share on social media, you can tag them with #FightOfSteel. That way it would be easier for us to get it!.


We welcome you to try the game![/h3]

[*] Fix bug for some gamepad button malfunction in Shop or Customization pages.

notes.title: A Beta Test for Fight of Steel, a Robot Fighting Game, is Open For Registration
notes.content:
[h3]　　Digital Crafter announced today that their new fighting game, Fight of Steel, will hold a limited test play starting from April 27th. The game is said to be including elements of role-playing and adventure. And it is now open for application. They released the latest development progress video for the community.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/da436d172b12d25dcb47c9a1981f919f16d5c36a.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=QgwZTAr3pBs;full][/previewyoutube]
The game is still in the process of development. The developers improved game graphics and sound effects between the playtest version and the video.

[h3]　　Fight of Steel is a fighting game set in a futuristic mechanical style; it is the sequel to the Digital Crafter fighting games after two years. The game is with a very different style from the previous game, Fight of Animals. But the Digital Crafter team insists on making fighting games more accessible for players to enjoy the charm of fighting games. They simplified the input for moves. While the input commands are simplified, the EX move and the OVERDRIVE (overload) system allow veterans of fighting games to play with a more advanced game experience.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/0d791bfe6081bef82bca1e459df0143643814aab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/2a1b90d036b2022963ce062db81941b3b400e0dd.png[/img]

[h3]　　The first easter egg released by the official team is the heroine of the story mode - Artemis. The first time a fighting game and VTuber collaborate. From the in-game artwork shared here, you can see Artemis wearing a combat suit. What kind of story and interaction will be between her and the protagonist?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/ae8e0d6f7c961a88561da29eb1113da141ee99b4.png[/img]
Does the mysterious girl who suddenly appears and is seriously injured relate to the protagonist's memory?

[h3]　　This beta test provides not only the general Arcade Mode but also other Modes of the game. The dev team included the first three chapters of the Story Mode, Challenge Mode, and Online Matches in the test version. Dozens of switchable moves and more than ten preset STEEL units so that players can experience other different aspects of the game other than fighting.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/94dc881246cfabc2eda25e930f40dd7ea675f68f.png[/img]
As the story mode progresses, you will encounter a variety of opponents

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/2e49909be148e7d811595c9ad17e264551e92640.png[/img]
You can unlock different moves and parts in the shop

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/e30ce5d8d771cc7d968d5b01d905c6b7269c9158.png[/img]
In Challenge Mode, players can build an optimized fighter according to the opponents encountered with the Property System design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/8b3ca2bb290f2f6d1bd8ec5530d3bd6c108e583b.png[/img]
Online matches are available during the beta test. Players can fight with pro players from all over the world.

[h3]　　Digital Crafter states that the beta test of Fight of Steel will last for seven days, from April 27th to May 4th. Players who applied for the playtest will receive a Steam key for the playtest on opening day. But they will remove the playtest data after the internal test ends. Along with this event, Digital Crafter will also release a lot of new information about the game in a few days. Players could get those updates by following their Facebook page or Steam game page.[/h3]

[h2][url=https://7obmow74ffw.typeform.com/to/RpKnmG8y]Application form for 1st wave beta test[/url][/h2]

notes.title: STEEL Design Contest for Fight of Steel Starts Now!
notes.content:
About:
Fight of Steel, a new game in development by Digital Crafter, is a game of infinite possibilities. Players are allowed to organize their own move set and customize the look of their fighter bots.  

Do you want to see a fighter designed by you in the game? This time we want you to join the project! Don’t miss the chance if you’re a Mecha fan! Join the contest! Whether your design idea is super cool or silly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/3021dfbe512ec61a7c17177f46acdaca28d036c9.png[/img]

Rules:
1. Download the spec layout for the design event.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/136b4f85795d60b4d254d448d78da7e3dded9acb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/851c2d417ac561036ee1867c61793302903fb0db.png[/img][/url]
2. Draw your STEEL(Fighter Bot) design on the spec layout. You can add more images if it’s needed. (Outline in the spec layout is just for reference. Fighter design should be mainly humanoid.）
3. Join Digital Crafter Discord server https://discord.gg/rPcHb6C
 and send your design to #steel-design-contest-submission-only channel; And provide the information listed below:
    - STEEL Name:
    - Designer:
    - Description or Backstory( within 100 words):

Prize:
After the deadline for submission, we will start open voting for the designs. The STEEL design getting the most votes will be 3D-modeled and included in Fight of Steel!

Designers of the top 3 voted designs will receive:
Steam gift points 50 USD
Fight of Steel Steam key * 1
Fight of Animals Steam key * 1
Fight of Gods Steam key * 1
Egg Dog stuffed toy * 1

Lottery of Steam keys for voters:
If you joined our Discord and voted for the designs during the event, we will draft 5 voters and give the winners games made by Digital Crafter, Steam key of their choice.

Deadlines and Dates:
Submission Deadline:From today to April 05
Voting: April 06-13
Result: April 15

Note:
1. Digital Crafter reserves the right to adjust event rules and other details or cancel the event.
2. Right of modifying the Design submitted by the winner is granted to Digital Crafter.
3. All contestants submitting designs grant Digital Crafter the right to use the designs including, but not limited to social media, media, and other commercial use.
